reason: Feasibility/schedule lens: REFUTED. The code itself is buildable byte-identical-when-off and fail-soft. The schedule and the gating are not. (1) Dependency chain. H2 is only allowed bundled with E7 tempfuse and needs its count guard. E7 is unbuilt (no tempfuse code in tools/), the v3 value lens refuted it (+0.0008 central), and R10 cuts it FIRST. H2 also needs H1, and it comes after K3/K3b in agent hours on 26 Sep. E7 (3-5 h) plus H2 (4-5 h) puts code at the earliest on the afternoon of 26 Sep. (2) Gate. Its own kill rule needs the honest LOEO lab by 26 Sep 18:00 UTC. The friend is silent. The code cannot reach any friend before that deadline anyway. The harness is misattributed: the B26/axis-flip LOEO arms ran on friend B's port of the 0.947-era public stack, not on x138, so it has no readmit, gapfill, V1284, lowrefine or insertion. Its record on this exact class does not predict the LB: axis-flip was +0.0187 on honest LOEO and -0.001 on the LB (probe 19). Z-flip was +0.0088 honest and -0.003/-0.009 on the LB (RESULTS.md l.87-107). exp60 is in-sample, which the idea itself concedes. So the only real gate is one LB slot, S7 on 27 Sep <= 12:00, scored ~20:00. R4 needs +0.002 there, with P ~0.1-0.2 and a 2-run SD of ~0.003. (3) Dummy gates. A detection-map change breaks the pre-registered K2 gates (LOWDET N == exp56 per clip, raw nodes 121,777). New gates would have to be pre-registered on 26 Sep. The +-1% count guard freezes node count, so any recall gain can only come as swaps. (4) Runtime. 7.73 h (L35 upper bound) + 0.13 h (lowrefine) + 0.38 h = 8.24 h. That crosses the 8.0 h insertion gate. H1, from the same lens, says not to move DIVINS later (15-55:1 loss), yet H2 requires exactly that move, and the move forces a new FD dummy. Left unmoved, ~10-15 tail clips lose the insertion (~-0.0001). The run stays under 12 h in all cases, including the 1.25x-slow world (~11.1 h, deadline tail <= 11.74 h). The +26 s/clip/shard figure is an upper bound on GPU only. The exp58 'detection+edges' 211.6-235.5 s already includes edge prediction. It leaves out a second strided zarr read of W frames per window, and every chunk is decompressed again. (5) Implementation traps, all fixable but costly. x138 cell 4 is a chain of exact-anchor patches: edge-TTA anchors on the whole det_tta block, readmit and V1284 anchor on the coord_offset line (the x122 silent-failure precedent). The phase patch must come last and re-anchor. zarr[t,:,2::4,2::4] can be 1 px shorter than target_shape, and _load_frame then trilinear-RESIZES instead of shifting, so it needs padding. P(executed, gated and LB-scored by 27 Sep 12:00) ~0.1 (guess). E[gain] ~+0.0001. It is last in the queue and would compete with K3/K3b and E7.
fix: Drop it from the pre-29 Sep plan. Do not bundle it into K4. If E7 is actually built and its dummy passes, ship E7 alone in S6 so that a clean readout is possible. Keep H2 as a post-deadline or friend-idle experiment, as an arm on the LOEO port with friend_a_exp02_loeo20 as primary. Should it ever be revived, do the following. Put the phase view on the secondary model only (+1 encode, ~+0.19 h), so the forecast stays <= 8.05 h without moving DIVINS. Read full-resolution frames once and slice both phases, so zarr is not decompressed twice. Zero-pad the 2::4 slice to target_shape, never interpolate it. Anchor the patch after the V1284 patch and assert a 'PHASE_TTA_ACTIVE' marker. Pre-register new dummy gates (LOWDET N and raw nodes within +-1%) before the build.
realistic_gain: ~+0.0001 expected (P(executed and scored by 27 Sep 12:00) ~0.1 x P(LB >= +0.002 | executed) ~0.1-0.2 x ~+0.002-0.003). If it ships without the lock-step DIVINS move, the insertion loss on tail clips offsets ~-0.0001, so net ~0.
